first_divergence: Security promises password changes, but an existing-password account receives 409 from the initialization-only endpoint, even when current_password is supplied.
environment: Local Next production build 3017, API 8017, real local PostgreSQL; not production.
fix: Require and verify the current password for changes; compare-and-set exact old hash, audit and increment session_version in one transaction. Initial setup still cannot overwrite an existing password.
account_state: Authenticated /auth/me returns has_password, used by the server-rendered Security page. Only a boolean is exposed.
security: shared rate limiter and signed frontend auth proxy
current_password redacted by backend and frontend telemetry scrubbers
first-party HttpOnly/Secure/SameSite=Lax cookie rotated; token absent from browser JSON
stale concurrent hash rejected without revoking new session
remaining: Native credential submission requires user handoff under browser credential-change policy. Production release/retest pending. Email recovery and company IdP checks remain separate open work.
